title: Circumnuclear Molecular Gas in Low-redshift Quasars and Matched Star-forming Galaxies
question: Is the circumnuclear molecular gas mass surface density systematically enhanced in luminous low-z quasars relative to matched inactive star-forming galaxies?

data.bands: Band 6, redshifted 12CO(2-1) and ~1.3 mm rest continuum
data.sensitivity: 1 sigma 0.26-0.41 mJy/beam (quasars), 0.16-0.56 mJy/beam (galaxies) in CO cubes

what.value: Quasar sample properties (PG/HE quasars) and galaxy M*/SFR from MPA-JHU

evidence.quote: SFRs are measured with H$\alpha$ line emission for the SDSS galaxies (cite: 2004MNRAS.351.1151B)
$\alpha_{\rm CO} = 2.6~M_\odot$ pc$^{-2}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$ is recommended, which has 0.4 dex standard deviation
$\sim 12\%$ of the total flux measured with the IRAM 30 m telescope (cite: 2007A&A...470..571B)

recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting after uv continuum subtraction

recipe.goal: Measure CO line luminosity in 700 pc and 2 kpc apertures
recipe.method: Convolve cubes to common physical aperture, integrate line flux, convert to L'CO(2-1)

assumptions: R21 = 1; alpha_CO = 1.3 Msun pc^-2 (K km/s)^-1 (~0.4 dex uncertainty) for both samples

recipe.method: Azimuthally averaged CO integrated intensity at matched physical resolution, rings with step theta_maj/2
assumptions: Sky projection, no inclination correction (cos i ~ factor 2 possible)

recipe.goal: Test XDR temperature effect on CO(2-1)
recipe.method: RADEX non-LTE models at T_kin = 30-500 K
key_parameters: n_H2 = 1e5 cm^-3; N_CO/dV = 2.5e16 cm^-2 (km/s)^-1; background 2.73 K

evidence.quote: CO line luminosities are $\sim (2-7) \times 10^7$ K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$ for the quasar sample
we obtained $M_{\rm mol} = (2.7-9.5) \times 10^7~M_\odot$ for the quasar sample

answer_key.quantity: L'CO(2-1) within 2 kpc, quasars vs galaxies

evidence.loc: 3.5 Molecular gas mass surface density profiles

evidence.quote: full-width at zero intensity (FWZI) $\sim 400-500$ km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels used for uv continuum subtraction
Clean threshold, masking, cell and image size
Velocity ranges used to integrate CO maps (except PG1149-110)
Aperture photometry method and centering for 700 pc and 2 kpc fluxes
Exact ellint parameters (center, inclination, position angle)
How the uncertainties on S_CO were derived
missing_for_reproduction: Clean parameters, masks and line-free channels
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging and flux extraction parameters are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Data public (single project), recipe simple, results numeric (Table 3 fluxes, masses).
